title: The Picnic Pair of Cups
youtube_title: The Picnic Pair of Cups | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Greta is just outside the fun, close to a second cup you did not forget this time. Zola changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Greta has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
